# Vendored libraries

These files are copied unmodified from npm so the planner runs offline and from
`file://` without a build step.

| File | Package | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preact.umd.js` | [preact@10.24.3](https://github.com/preactjs/preact) `dist/preact.umd.js` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller |
| `preact-hooks.umd.js` | [preact@10.24.3](https://github.com/preactjs/preact) `hooks/dist/hooks.umd.js` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller |
| `htm.umd.js` | [htm@3.1.1](https://github.com/developit/htm) `dist/htm.umd.js` | Apache-2.0, Copyright 2018 Google Inc. |
